end.summary:
Discussed earthworms and how their tunnels may let air and water reach roots.
Practised observing soil animals under leaves and moving them gently with a stick.
Named ants, beetles, earthworms, and millipedes; the insect classification mix-up was not corrected.
Teach-back was not passed; Pihu said they felt tired and ended the lesson.
end.parentNote: Pihu practised thinking about how earthworm tunnels can help air and water reach plant roots, and how to observe small soil animals safely without touching them. They listed several examples and considered a careful observation method. The mix-up that all the named animals are insects was not corrected later in this lesson. At home, you could look under a leaf together and sort the animals into simple groups, such as insects and other small soil animals.
